editorialCorrections.change: Corrected simplistic NREM=deep/REM=shallow dichotomy using NHLBI primary material. REM does not mean awake.
24–72h retained as the textbook reference, never a universal diagnostic threshold; current symptom-based assessment checked with NIDDK.
Individual fluid limits and professional review retained; NIDDK kidney guidance confirms limits may be needed. No common fluid dose authored.

Retained that dreaming is common in REM and that dreams alone do not classify stage. NINDS PDF that also mentions non-REM dreams returned403; its search excerpt was not treated as a full-page verification.
